messages:
melissa: FYI customer 'MapleHealth' reporting intermittent 502s and big latency spikes for eu-west. They say traffic suddenly routed to us-east around 03:12 UTC for ~2m, adding ~220-300ms. They pasted a couple req_ids. Can eng-sre look? :frowning:
cheng: on it. can you paste the sample req lines and ask for the probe/heartbeat logs 03:05-03:20? sounds like a failover race, not capacity.
melissa: here's the sample they sent:
```
req_id=abc123 region=eu-west -> routed=us-east status=502 latency=312ms trace=gw->rdr-proxy->model-svc
client_time=2026-03-16T03:12:08Z
```
samir: grabbing probe logs. infra-bot, surface eu-west healthcheck events 03:05-03:20 please.
infra-bot: ALERT: probe-eu-west heartbeat=failed at 2026-03-16T03:11:58Z (timeout); restored at 2026-03-16T03:12:30Z. Failure reason: TLS handshake timeout to probe agent (client 10.4.22.11). Consecutive misses: 1. Routing policy triggered fallback to regional-fallback-pool.
cheng: consecutive misses: 1? our routing policy will fallback immediately on single miss for some tiers. that explains the quick jump. check probe TTL and affinity.
lena: config excerpt (redacted):
```
routing: {preferred: eu-west, fallback: us-east, probe_miss_threshold: 1, probe_grace_seconds: 5}
```
lena: probe_miss_threshold=1 is aggressive for flaky agent networks; a transient TLS handshake spike will flip routes. note scheduler resends at +7s so race window ~7-15s.
melissa: customer thought session pinning would keep them in eu-west for ~30s. why did it flip immediately?
cheng: two controls: probe-based fallback and sticky-session TTL. probe-triggered route updates can affect new requests; affinity_ttl for that pool is 8s (old default) so it's short. that explains near-immediate re-route.
samir: root hypothesis: transient TLS handshake timeout between control-plane probe and probe-agent in eu-west -> single probe miss triggers fallback -> low affinity_ttl means even recently-pinned sessions are rebalanced -> customer sees cross-region spike and a few 502s.
lena: mitigation ideas:
- bump probe_miss_threshold to 2 (require two misses) :white_check_mark:
- increase affinity_ttl to 30s for regional pools :white_check_mark:
- add short suppression window (20s) to stop immediate flip-flop :eyes:
- surface TLS handshake metrics from agents; if persistent, route to networking team
cheng: also consider NAT rotation or ephemeral client IP causing agent-side rate limiting. samir, can you grep agent logs for `TLS handshake` and socket errors 03:10-03:15?
samir: running quick checks:
```
# fetch probe logs
rdrctl logs --region eu-west --service probe-agent --since 2026-03-16T03:05 --until 2026-03-16T03:20 > /tmp/probe-eu.log
# grep
grep -E "TLS handshake|timeout|socket error|rate-limited" /tmp/probe-eu.log | tail -n 50
```
(snip) I see repeated `TLS handshake timeout` entries around 03:11:55-03:12:02 from agent 10.4.22.11 and one earlier `client cert verify failed` at 02:59. Not a mass outage but a burst on that host.
melissa: customer concerned about billing for retries. did those 502s generate billable tokens?
lena: gateway 502s typically only bill gateway processing tokens, not model tokens. we have a finance flag to credit gateway failures. melissa, ask them for req_ids and we'll evaluate credits.
cheng: action plan:
1) short-term (<30m): canary change: set probe_miss_threshold=2 and affinity_ttl=30s for eu-west routing pool on 10% nodes.
2) mid-term (24-48h): add suppression window, emit TLS handshake metrics, audit agent cert rotation and NAT logs.
3) customer comms: melissa to collect req_ids and send explanation + offer credit if confirmed.
samir: applying canary:
```
rdrctl patch routing eu-west --set probe_miss_threshold=2 --set affinity_ttl=30 --canary=0.1
```
infra-bot: PLAYBOOK: routing patch enqueued, canary=10%, target nodes: eu-west pool 3/10. change id=chg-20260316-42
melissa: thanks. what rollback criteria?
cheng: watch region_routing_rate, probe_miss_rate, cross_region_latency_p50/p95. rollback if canary error rate >2x baseline or probe_miss_rate spikes. 10m watch.
lena: also watch for route-flapping >3 switches in 5m -> revert. filing follow-up ticket TKT-4521 to add TLS handshake metric and review agent cert rotation.
samir: canary applied; after 6m canary is stable, probe misses on canary nodes are 0 and route-stability improved. keeping canary 10% for 30m then promote.
melissa: DM'ing customer: "we observed a transient probe TLS handshake timeout that triggered an immediate fallback. we've rolled a canary config to reduce sensitivity and will credit gateway errors if you send req_ids. sorry for the disruption." will paste final wording here for approval.
cheng: wording OK. :thumbsup:
lena: filing billing request once we get req_ids.
melissa: customer sent 5 req_ids; filing for credit. closing once finance confirms. :white_check_mark:
